display.purpose: Page titles only. Bebas Neue, uppercase, condensed.

metric.purpose: Big dashboard stat numbers. Bebas Neue for quantities.

body.purpose: All readable prose and field values. Inter.

label.purpose: Card headers, stat labels, eyebrows, badges. 0.7rem tracked uppercase.

shadows.name: inset-edge-light
shadows.purpose: Default lift on cards/stats — light catching a top edge. No dark drop shadow.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest — the one element allowed to emit light.

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: The floating nav pill only (with backdrop-blur).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring, paired with a red border.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Buttons on hover; stats lift translateY(-3px).

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Eyebrow dot — the only ambient motion. Suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ship-it action per screen. Red gradient with signal glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; padding:0.7rem 1.4rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9999px; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.88rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.02em; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ed072c,#b30420); box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(237,7,44,0.4); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, filter 0.22s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); filter:brightness(1.08); box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(237,7,44,0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.65; cursor:wait; transform:none; filter:none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Translucent fill, hairline border shifting red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; padding:0.7rem 1.4rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius:9999px; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.88rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.02em; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.86); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.025); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease, color 0.22s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); border-color:rgba(237,7,44,0.55); background:rgba(237,7,44,0.06); color:#fff; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark field, hairline border, red focus ring — the one consistent red moment per screen.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; padding:0.75rem 0.9rem; border-radius:0.75rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background:rgba(0,0,0,0.35); color:#fff; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.92rem; outline:none; transition:border-color 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:rgba(237,7,44,0.7); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(237,7,44,0.14); background:rgba(0,0,0,0.45); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Translucent panel over black, inset edge-light, tracked uppercase header. Never nested.
components.html:

components.name: Status Badge (Uploaded)
components.description: Pill status badge. Green = uploaded; always carries the status word, never hue alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:0.2rem 0.7rem; border-radius:9999px; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; border:1px solid transparent; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:rgba(255,255,255,0.68); } .ds-badge-uploaded { background:rgba(46,213,115,0.12); color:#6ee7a1; border-color:rgba(46,213,115,0.3); }

components.description: Pill nav link inside the floating glass bar. Muted at rest, red-tinted fill when active.

narrative.overview: A producer working a beat at 2 a.m. in a blacked-out room, one red light on. The interface is that room: a true-black surface where everything recedes except the work in front of you, lit by a single brand red that behaves like signal. This is a product, not a poster — design serves the workflow (beat to package to schedule to upload to analytics) and never competes with it. Screens carry a lot of metadata, so the system leans on space, hairline structure, and a strict accent budget to keep density reading as control, not clutter.
keyCharacteristics: True-black canvas (#000) with translucent white surfaces layered on top
A single brand red (#ed072c) used as signal, on a tight budget
Condensed display type (Bebas Neue) for headings + metrics; Inter for body
Flat surfaces lit from within (inset highlight) + ambient red glow — not drop shadows
Refined, restrained motion: subtle hover lift, crisp focus, nothing bouncy

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is signal, not paint. It marks the one live/primary thing on a screen and the focused field — nowhere else. More than one red element competing for the eye means you've overspent.

rules.name: The Status-Is-More-Than-Hue Rule
rules.body: Upload status (uploaded / failed / scheduled / ready) must always carry a text label, never color alone.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bebas for titles and numbers; Inter for everything else. Never set body copy in Bebas, never a page title in Inter.

rules.name: The Caps-Are-Labels Rule
rules.body: All-caps + wide tracking is reserved for small labels and display headings. Never for a sentence the user has to read.

rules.name: The No-Drop-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces don't cast dark shadows onto black. Depth is the inset highlight plus red glow.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-The-Nav Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-blur glass is a deliberate signature for exactly one element — the floating nav pill. Forbidden as a default card/panel treatment.

dos: Do keep red on a tight budget — one live/primary element + the focused field per screen.
Do set titles and big numbers in Bebas Neue, everything readable in Inter.
Do convey depth with the inset top-highlight and red glow; keep surfaces flat.
Do pair every status with its word, and verify status colors aren't hue-only.
Do keep body/muted text at #ffffff99 or lighter-toward-ink; check >=4.5:1 on black before going dimmer.
Do give dense screens space and one primary action — density should read as control.
donts: Don't build the cluttered, busy dashboard — no wall of equal panels, no competing accents.
Don't spend red as decoration (multiple glowing buttons, red borders everywhere). Rarity is the point.
Don't nest cards, or add border-left/border-right colored side-stripes as accents.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient text. The primary button's gradient fill is fine; gradient text is banned.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface — it's reserved for the nav pill only.
Don't set body copy in tracked uppercase or in Bebas; caps are for small labels only.
Don't drop dark drop-shadows onto the black canvas.
